title: Governed Runtime Handoff & MAS Cast Integration
objective: Add governed NPC/creature runtime handoff and MAS cast-integration projections with structured import mapping while preserving Character/NPC/Creature definition, placement, live-instance, conversion and downstream adventure/session authority.

scope.purpose: Provide explicit, provenance-preserving handoff adapters from completed MNCS candidates into governed runtime/MAS cast workflows without minting duplicate entity or session truth.
scope.completion_gate: MNCS candidates can be handed into runtime/MAS cast workflows through explicit governed mappings without duplicating Character/NPC/Creature entity authority or downstream adventure/session state.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.4 and MNCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json were reconsulted after exact-tree MNCS-20 publication.
The DAG contains no MNCS-20-triggered rotation or newly eligible unfinished interstitial that overrides MNCS strict order; MNCS-22 is the next unfinished surviving tranche.
PPIA-02 and Character/NPC/Creature owners retain Definition, placement, live-instance, conversion and entity authority; MNCS-22 supplies handoff projections/adapters only.
MAS and downstream Adventure/Scene/Session owners retain their canonical runtime/cast/session truth; integration must reference rather than duplicate those owner records.
MNCS-22 absorbs baseline MNCS-22 plus the documented MNCS-23 structured handoff/import-mapping residual.
MNCS-22 is selected_not_started only; no implementation branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue.
The independent ui-implementation lane remains UISR-10 selected_not_started and player-species remains MVPS-05 selected_not_started; both are preserved unchanged.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue in the product-development lane. On that command, governed-start MNCS-22 with the OPS3 execution guard; do not implement while selected_not_started.

stop_reason.evidence: MNCS-22 is selected_not_started after fresh post-MNCS-20 DAG/backlog reconciliation; no bounded MNCS-22 execution is active.
